features.name: Plane A smoke — the harness posts a fresh imposter and drives it directly
Cross-tool consistency — engine, rift-lint, and rift-verify agree on the corpus
Core serving — predicates, cycling, copy, FSM, headers, templates, forward, gateway
Faults and transport errors
Scripting engines and runaway bounds
Response templating — request variables and date tokens
Response behaviors — copy, lookup, wait, shellTransform, decorate
Spaces (flow-id partitioning) and FSM declarative-scenario state
Admin surface — stub-by-id, enable/disable, savedRequests filtering, flow-state KV, atomic PUT /imposters
Single-port gateway, binary-mode responses, self-signed HTTPS, and Prometheus metrics
Proxy record/replay — proxyOnce, proxyTransparent, proxyAlways chains, and predicateGenerators
Incremental reload (rift#316) — POST /admin/reload reconciles toward --configfile
Intercept / TLS-MITM forward-proxy (rift#413) — CONNECT interception with rule matching
Error-response envelope — the standard {"errors":[{code,message}]} contract on every error door
Behaviors and repeat on inject, proxy and fault responses (rift#1184)
Flow-store backend parity — the in-memory and Redis stores give identical results
Front door routing and single-port gateway dispatch (rift docs/features/front-door.md, gateway.md)
Metrics — the Prometheus families on --metrics-port and the admin GET /metrics
Match diagnostics — _rift.warnings stub analysis, the X-Rift-Debug report, journal matchOutcome
Declarative flow state — _rift.stateOps, fail-loud flowState config, the clear-flow admin route
TLS termination options and HTTP/2 negotiation (rift docs/features/tls.md, #977/#1029)
Admin REST long tail — system routes, listing views, delete-all, teardown, stub surgery, spaces, scenarios, body cap
Mountebank compatibility — predicates, imposter options and response forms the corpus only loads
